id3.description: The person's identifying name(s) within the family group or by which he/she is uniquely socially identified.

id4.description: The part of a name a person usually has in common with some other members of his/her family, as distinguished from his/her given names.

id5.description: An honorific form of address commencing a name, used when addressing a person by name, whether by mail, by phone, or depending upon cultural situation in person.

id6.description: Additional term used following a person name.

id8.description: Details of alternative representations such as local codesets or language variations.

id9.description: Indicates that this is the name by which a person chooses to be identified.

id10.description: An indicator of specific conditions or rules that should be applied to the use of the person name.

id11.description: The person's full name as a concatenation of its name parts.

id20.description: The period of time for which the name usage applies.

id21.description: The combination of identifier type, identifier issuer and identifier name that specify the link between this name and reporting or other unique identifier usage.

id22.description: Name of the representational form used.

id23.description: Alternative Representation of this subject of care name using alternative styles of representation such as characters or language character set variations for local display.

at24.description: The subject’s name as it is to be used for reporting, when used with a specific identifier.

at25.description: A type reserved for the identification of unnamed newborn babies.

at26.description: The name used by the subject for business or professional purposes.

at27.description: The name used by the subject of care prior to marriage.

at29.description: Any other name by which the subject is known, or has been known by in the past.

at32.description: The name recorded is a fictitious or partial name.

at33.description: This is a misspelling, but should be retained for potential future matching.

at34.description: This name should not be used when referring to this subject.

at35.description: By Law, this name and all names prior to it in the name sequence are not to be displayed or indicated in any way when searching for or dealing with information and events associated with a name that is subsequent to this one in the name sequence.

at36.description: A name for which episodes are attached that should only be accessible to specified authorised persons.

at37.description: A temporary name issued where the subject's name has not been determined.

ac2.description: An indicator of specific conditions or rules that should be applied to the use of the person name. (synthesised)
